user.title: Showroom signage
user.description: Plays pictures and videos from Home Assistant's media folder (Media > My media) on the TVs. Set up playlists and screens afterwards with Configure.

add_screen.description: Pick the TV's Cast entity (for example media_player.one_tv_cast), not a universal player built on it: those drop the title and picture.

data.name: Name
data.picture_seconds: How long each picture stays up on this TV

data_description.name: Leave empty to use the TV's name.
data_description.workday_entity: For example a Workday sensor for your country, so public holidays are skipped.
data_description.power_entity: What powers the TV itself: for example its media player or a switch.
data_description.keep_on: Starts it again within a minute if it is stopped or the TV leaves the slideshow.
data_description.enabled: Off: stopped, TV powered off, the schedule leaves it alone.
data_description.schedule_mode: The default schedule (Configure › Default schedule), its own (below), or none: started and stopped by hand.
